user.title: OpenCARWINGS
user.description: Connect with your OpenCARWINGS API key.

data_description.api_key: Sign in to the OpenCARWINGS server in a browser, open your account settings and copy the API key from there.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to read fresh data from the server. This never wakes the car. Only a command button does that.
data_description.api_base_url: Base URL of your OpenCARWINGS server. The public instance is https://opencarwings.viaaq.eu
data_description.command_pin: Your OpenCARWINGS account's PIN, set on the server. Without it the server refuses door lock and unlock, horn, lights and remote start. Leave blank if your account has no PIN.
data_description.gps_max_radius_km: Distance from Home, in km. Fixes beyond it are ignored and the last good one stays on the map. Useful when the head unit has the wrong map region or stale map data and puts the car far from where it is. Set 0 to accept every fix.

reauth_confirm.title: OpenCARWINGS API key
reauth_confirm.description: This integration now signs in with an API key instead of a username and password. Open your account settings on the OpenCARWINGS server and copy the API key from there.

data_description.api_key: The API key from your account settings on the OpenCARWINGS server.

error.auth: The server rejected that API key.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

data_description.api_key: Only needed if your API key changed or you are switching accounts. Leave blank to keep the current one.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to read fresh data from the server. This never wakes the car. Only a command button does that.
data_description.api_base_url: Base URL of your OpenCARWINGS server. The public instance is https://opencarwings.viaaq.eu
data_description.command_pin: Your OpenCARWINGS account's PIN, set on the server. Without it the server refuses door lock and unlock, horn, lights and remote start. Leave blank if your account has no PIN.
data_description.gps_max_radius_km: Distance from Home, in km. Fixes beyond it are ignored and the last good one stays on the map. Useful when the head unit has the wrong map region or stale map data and puts the car far from where it is. Set 0 to accept every fix.

error.auth: The server rejected that API key.

refresh.name: Refresh data
refresh.description: Read fresh data from the OpenCARWINGS server. This never wakes the car, it only re-reads what the server already knows. Use a command button to make the car report in.

entry_id.name: Account
entry_id.description: The account to refresh. Leave empty to refresh every configured account.
